Claim_Text: GVoC reaches 70.2% accuracy across 16,000 queries, improving over MACT by +5.8 points while using 23.7% fewer tokens.
Dataset_Sample: 16,000 queries across DocVQA, ChartQA, TableBench, MMLongBench
Confounders: Simulation assumes perfect spatial crop boundaries and synthetic state transitions.

Claim_Text: C-GVoC reliably suppresses false interventions to preserve optimal stopping accuracy with zero cost overhead.
Confounders: Raw data shows Monolithic 82.0% vs C-GVoC 76.0% (-6.0%) and +17% token overhead.
Statistical_Support: p = 0.1460 (McNemar exact); underpowered to prove equivalence

Claim_Text: In live empirical evaluation, unregularized intervention risks over-triggering, while conservative penalization partially mitigates harm.
Format-constrained concise decoding eliminates truncation and restores accuracy under 60-token limits.
Confounders: Selected post-hoc probe on pilot instances.
Final_Decision: QUALIFY (Frame as Engineering Finding on small probe)

Claim_Text: The 20-instance confirmatory experiment independently validated observation scaling.
Confounders: Overlap audit proved 20/20 instances were in pilot; only 10 unique images exist.
Statistical_Support: N_eff approx 10 due to image clustering
Final_Decision: REWRITE (Relabel strictly as Exploratory Pilot Probe)

Claim_Text: Unguided geometric center-cropping degrades accuracy from 60.0% to 25.0% by excising peripheral context.
Confounders: Clean unconfounded contrast (C4 Crop vs C2 Low-Res) with matched concise prompts.
Statistical_Support: p = 0.0391 (McNemar exact); 8/15 failures physically cut text
Final_Decision: KEEP (Core empirical finding on spatial grounding)

Claim_Text: The Data Processing Inequality proves that observation scaling is necessary and superior to reasoning.
Confounders: DPI bounds mutual information under downsampling; it does not guarantee crop success.
Statistical_Support: Inequality is exact under stated Markov assumptions
Final_Decision: QUALIFY (Frame as upper bound on reasoning over blurry inputs)
